interactive_login_steps.message: FIFO: Log in to ICICI Bank — we'll navigate to your statement automatically once you're in.

transactions_steps._comment: Let the overview page fully settle after login

transactions_steps.expression: () => { try { const els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')); for (const el of els) { if (el.children.length > 3) continue; const cls = (el.className || '').toString().toLowerCase(); const txt = (el.innerText || '').trim(); if (!txt) continue; if (/(invest|mf|mutual|portfolio|wealth)/i.test(cls)) { const m = txt.match(/[\d,]+\.\d{2}/); if (m && parseFloat(m[0].replace(/,/g,'')) > 10000) return m[0]; } } const amtRe = /^\d{1,3}(?:,\d{2})*(?:,\d{3})\.\d{2}$/; for (const el of els) { if (el.children.length > 0) continue; const txt = (el.innerText || '').trim(); if (amtRe.test(txt)) { const val = parseFloat(txt.replace(/,/g,'')); if (val > 100000) return txt; } } return null; } catch(e) { return null; } }
transactions_steps._comment: Capture ICICI investment portfolio value from the overview page. Looks for amounts near investment/MF class names, falls back to any large Indian-format amount (>1 lakh). If it captures the wrong value, inspect the page DOM and refine this expression.

transactions_config._row_selector_note: ICICI renders each date-group with TWO tables: mobile (tr.transfer.trans_space, 3-col) and desktop (tr.transfer without trans_space, 5-col). We use only the desktop rows to avoid duplicates and to get the balance column.
transactions_config._view_more_selector_disabled: Using JS Strategy 2 only — finds > button right of 'Page N of N' text. The CSS selector was accidentally matching the DOWNLOAD DETAILS button.

columns._date_note: No date column in rows. Date lives in ancestor div.transaction > div.date (p.date-1=day, p.date-2=month). Year from sibling div.date-transaction-top p.date. base_crawler DOM finder uses closest('div.transaction') to assemble the full date.

_notes: ICICI Detailed Statement — actual 3-column <tr> structure (confirmed from icici_rows_debug.html):
td:nth-child(1) = td.remarks-details  →  category label + description in p.remark-pos

td:nth-child(2) = td.credit (cr-mob) OR td.debit → amount in

child
td:nth-child(3) = td.arrow-mob  →  SVG chevron, no text
NO date column in rows — date is in a parent/sibling element outside <tbody>.
base_crawler JS DOM-context finder walks up from each row to find nearest date string.
Date filter uses 'Transaction Period → Last 1 Year' preset — simpler than date pickers.
Angular SPA: no wait_for_load_state networkidle — use sleep steps instead.
text= selectors are case-sensitive against DOM textContent (not CSS-rendered text).
